_comment: What a deployment is for, as data (Game/Mission/Objectives): each template a list of steps -- kind restore_power, download or carry -- with the steps done before each (after), what the crew is told (text), a line under it while it is open (hint; hint_no_map when the briefing came without a map), whether it is only there when the power is out (only_when_power_out) and whether the crew only learns of it on finding the terminal dead (learnt_at_terminal). Read again when it changes while the game runs.

steps.text: Restore the power: reset the building's breaker.
steps.hint: The terminal is dead until then.

steps.text: Download the data from the terminal.
steps.hint_no_map: No map data for this site: search the buildings.

steps.text: Take the drive to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.

steps.text: Take a reading at each of the survey markers.
steps.hint: Stand at a marker while its reading is taken.

steps.text: Take the readings back to the shuttle.
steps.hint: It is waiting on the pad.
